subject: general
question: Who is the Union Minister of Corporate Affairs, as of March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirmala Sitharaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nirmala Sitharaman is the Union Minister of Corporate Affairs as of March 2023.
 
• She holds a significant portfolio in the Indian government, overseeing corporate regulation and promotion of better corporate governance.
 
• Sitharaman has previously served as the Defence Minister of India, showcasing her versatility and capability in handling different ministries.
 
• Her role involves implementing laws and regulations that enhance transparency, accountability, and the efficiency of corporate entities in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Ashwini Vaishnav
 Minister for Railways; Communications; Electronics & Information Technology.
 
 

 2) Piyush Goyal

 3) Nirmala Sitharaman
 Union Minister of Corporate Affairs and Finance Minister of India.
